queries: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.fee_count) AS total_fee_count, AVG(g.fee_count - a.avg_fee_count) AS average_count_excess FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_fee_count;

WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), cross_group AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(fee_count AS numeric)) AS avg_fee_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, SUM(g.fee_count) AS total_fee_records, AVG(g.fee_count - c.avg_fee_count) AS average_count_excess FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN cross_group AS c WHERE g.fee_count > c.avg_fee_count;
